name: Knox County, TN
findings: Knox County has 1,552 nonprofit organizations. 708 of them (46%) list at least one way to get involved in their tax returns or on their websites: membership, volunteering, public events, or civic and political action.
The most common is membership, listed by 548 organizations.
Religious organizations are the largest group offering opportunities (20% of those with an identified type).
Compared with 10 similar places, Knox County has about as many organizations offering opportunities per resident.

observations.title: Youth organizations stand out for public events
observations.text: 21 youth organizations here list public events, compared with about 9 in similar places of this size.

confidence.text: Based on 21 organizations here; 29% of all organizations here have no identified type.

observations.question: What role do youth organizations play in community life here? Who do they reach, and who might they miss?

observations.title: Religious organizations that list no opportunities
observations.text: 101 religious organizations here list none of the four kinds of opportunity in their tax returns or on their websites. Many may still offer them without describing them there.
